sentences: First k is 1 so fire once, then k becomes 2, fire twice, then k becomes 3, fire thrice, so three shots.
k goes 1 then 2 then 3, each time running fire, and after three the loop finishes on its own.
Start k at 1, loop runs while k is small, k keeps going up by itself until it passes 3, giving three fires.
Since k is 1, 2, 3 before stopping, fire happens once each value, so count is three shots.
The while checks k up to 3, and k advances each round automatically, so fire runs three times total.
